lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance, roughly circular blobs is visible on the mid-lateral flank, arranged in approximately five horizontal rows and ten vertical columns posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with longitudinal light-colored bands, forming a grid where the primary high-luminance blobs are positioned at the nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, displaying a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal edge and shadowing on the ventral edge of each ridge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of small, high-luminance blobs, primarily clustered in the lower-anterior and central regions of the fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A slender hitchhiking organism, likely a remora, is attached to the dorsal surface posterior to the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The left pectoral fin displays a dense, high-frequency cluster of small high-luminance spots that are notably smaller and more irregularly spaced than the blobs on the primary flank.
